u0: The agent has not yet completed the task and has no outstanding unanswered siren alarm. Any earlier alarm has been handled by toggling the switch, and the agent should continue toward the exit while responding to any new siren. If the siren rings and is not toggled, this normal progress is interrupted by a pending alarm that incurs a penalty.
u1: A siren is ringing and has not yet been turned off at the switch, so the obligation to respond to every alarm is currently pending. The agent must toggle the switch to clear the alarm and return to normal progress, or otherwise the exit cannot be completed successfully. If the exit is reached without a simultaneous toggle, completion remains blocked until the alarm is answered.
u2: The agent has reached the exit with the siren silent or with any ringing answered by a switch toggle, including a toggle made on the exit step. Both requirements are satisfied, so the task is successfully complete. No further objectives remain.
u3: The agent has reached the exit while the siren is still ringing and no switch toggle has yet answered it, so the exit arrival is not yet a successful finish. The outstanding alarm must be cleared by toggling the switch. Doing so satisfies the response requirement and completes the task; until then, completion remains pending.
